subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
(a)  A consultancy firm provides project management service in three sectors
Technology, Healthcare and Education. The Project management service
covers development and implementation of software for various MIS
requirements of its clients. The fees charged per project is as follows:
Technology:
` 90,000
